answer: Require a refundable bond that scales with how many accounts share a signup source. Each new account locks 10 tokens, and every additional account from the same payment or network origin doubles the next bond. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 10 × (2^1000 − 1) tokens, so it stalls after about 12 puppets (≈40,000 tokens). Honest agents pay 10 once and get it back. Like a jetty, it limits who can dock; the farm sees its horizon shrink, while a lone grove of real agents grows.
